meta.policy: Guided configured demonstration/opening, then Game.hint with keyed per-turn legal random action probability. Fixed shipped board/refill seed. Tool heuristic at 50% spent moves, goal-aware hammer/group-growth glove and watering, dice fallback; no lookahead. Unguided standard is first20 sensitivity only.
meta.score: 100*(1-standard guided baseline wins/N). Higher is harder for this policy only.
meta.uncertainty: Wilson 95% interval conditional on policy noise and fixed layout/refill; not a human win-rate interval.
